Overview Approval Disapproval Banter Location Remarks Romance Cinematics

A collection of Halsin's remarks and voicebarks in various locations or plot scenes throughout the game. Since Halsin may become a fully-featured party companion only after events in the middle of the Act Two, there are none such remarks for him within most locations or scenes of the Act One.

Act Two

Rosymorn Monastery and Crèche Y'llek

  • (Came up to a broken bridge at X: -106 Y: -184): “No use. We shall need to find another way across.”
  • (Entered a combat with drunk Kobolds): “These kobolds have had a skinful - their scent precedes them.”
  • (Found a githyanki skeleton, has been to the creche): “Old remains. Perhaps from when this place was first seized?”
    • (Hasn’t found the creche yet): “Githyanki, by the look of it.”
  • (The Giant Eagle calling for help in combat): “Not the most harmonious of birdsong - it may draw more eagles to us.”
  • (Entered the Dormitory[1]): “Curious. I had not expected githyanki sleeping arrangements to be so... conventional.”
  • (Read the parchment with the rules on the dormitory wall): “Such a rigid code. This must not be an easy place to come of age.”
  • (Looking at the devices in Stornugoss’ laboratory): “Curious contraptions. More advanced than what I had at my disposal in the Grove.”
  • (Saw anatomical diagrams in the Classroom): “Mind flayer anatomical sketches... wonderful level of detail. Wonderful and appalling.”
  • (Hit a training dummy in the far end of the Classroom): “I assume the genuine article is more intimidating.”
  • (Started a fight with sa'varsh Kethk and his students): “He holds sway over his pupils. They will kill for him - die for him.”
  • (Looking around in the Hatchery): “What is this place...?”
  • (Opened the apple crate in the corridor): “A warrior-in-training's diet.”
  • (Read the map in Captain’s Quarters): “The Sword Coast. There's Baldur's Gate. What are the githyanki planning...?”
  • (Solved the statue puzzle in Inquisitor’s Chamber): “The statues reveal a hidden path. Most clever.”
    • (Took the Blood of Lathander after destroying the barrier’s source): “The whole structure is collapsing!”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Time to get clear of this place.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “We need to be gone from here - now.”

Shadow-Cursed Lands

  • (Looking at the distorted land within Shadow Curse realm): “Silvanus guard us - the curse has churned up the very land itself...”
  • (Found a dead raven nearby Last Light Inn,  Arcana check):
    • (Successful): “The shadows claimed that poor creature. Its remains are tainted.”
    • (Failed): “Poor creature. This was no place for it to die.”
  • (Looking at the graveyard behind the Last Light Inn): “At least the shadow curse was not allowed to claim these dead.”
  • (Found fresh flowers near Oliver’s hovel): “Wildflowers growing amidst the darkness. Thaniel's missing half must be near.”
  • (Looking at the former battlefield[2]): “A great many druids once stood here to fight Ketheric Thorm. Few ever left.”
  • (Found old war machines in Shadow Curse realm): “The tools of warfare, left to rot... I remember when they were pristine. We thought victory was close at hand.”
  • (Met Rolan in the middle of SCL): “Rolan...? Is he looking to get himself killed?”

Reacting to the effect of the Shadow Curse:

  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, 1): “The shadows - I can feel them draining the life from me.”
  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, 2): “The curse will consume me entirely if I linger much longer.”
  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, 3): “The darkness is hungry here. I can feel them sapping my strength.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “I feel it also. Energy fading... I won't last long here.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “I cannot... cannot continue much longer.”
    • (Responding remark 3 - looking for a solution): “We must dispel the shadows if we are to survive.”
  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, looking for light source): “The shadow curse claws at me. Need some light.”
  • (Responding remark 1): “The longer I stay here, the more the shadows will take from me. We need light...”
  • (Responding remark 2): “A torch, campfire, candle - anything to force the shadows to retreat.”
  • (Responding remark 3): “I cannot survive long without a light source.”
  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, the answer to Shadowheart who doesn’t feel it, 1): “I do not share in your fortune - the shadows hunt me. I need a torch.”
  • (Feeling the effect of Shadow Curse, the answer to Shadowheart who doesn’t feel it, 2): “I feel the curse... it's draining me...”
  • (A torch snuffed out in deeper curse, 1): “A torch is no use against the shadow curse.”
    • (Remark 2): “No flame can withstand the shadow curse. Torches are useless here.”
    • (Remark 3): “The curse is strong here - hungry. I will consume any flame.”
    • (Remark 4): “The shadow curse is strong here - too strong for a simple torch.”

Dealing with Shadow Curse victims:

  • (Found Dead Druid's Journal,  Nature check):
    • (Successful): “A fellow druid's research into the nature of this foul shadow curse. These insights may prove valuable.”
    • (Failed): “Notes on the shadow curse. I can only hope such knowledge is never needed beyond this place.”
  • (Saw an animal killed by the Shadow Curse): “The shadow curse spares none of nature's creations.”
  • (Saw the dead grove tieflings,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “They met a cruel end - but it looks as though they put up a fight.”
    • (Failed): “Poor souls. They met a cruel end.”
  • (Saw the dead cursed ox,  Investigation check):
    • (Successful): “This ox died fighting - it looks like it put its horns to good use.”
    • (Failed): “Poor creature. Yoked into servitude, only to die like this.”
  • (Saw the dead cursed ox’s master,  Medicine check):
    • (Successful): “These wounds aren't from a weapon - they're from a horn.”
    • (Failed): “An unenviable fate.”

Last Light Inn

  • (Found a Selûnite shrine in the cellar, the answer to Shadowheart (Sharran)): “Driven into concealment, perhaps?”
    • (the answer to Shadowheart (non-Sharran)): “You are no longer the same person you once were. You are better.”
  • (Saw Rolan’s magical projection after he left the haven): “He went into the shadows alone? Madness.”

Reithwin Town

  • (Entering Reithwin Town from the bridge, near Tollhouse): “This town - I remember it too well. Much druid and Harper blood was spilled in taking it... only to lose it again.”
  • (Upon killing Gerringothe Thorm): “The shadow curse warped her utterly - death was a kindness.”
  • (At the House of Healing, upon killing Malus Thorm): “ A rotten heart beats no more. Good riddance.”
    • (If Malus Thorm killed himself): “If only that foul creature had been compelled to perform surgery on himself years before.”
    • (If Malus Thorm was killed by his nurses): “Slaughtered by his own minions. A deservedly-ignominious end.”
  • (Upon entering The Waning Moon): “I remember this place. We thought perhaps we might toast our victory here... but alas, it was not to be.”
  • (Upon killing Thisobald Thorm): “Dead at last - but it will be some time before his foul vapours fade from my nostrils.”
  • (Voss's Qua'nith Psionic Detector activated, knows its purpose): “Voss' psionic device is sounding out - it detects something.”
    • (Detector's purpose unknown): “That strange contraption from Voss is making noise. Odd...”
  • (After defeating Ch'r'ai Tska'an and her hunter squad): “A githyanki hunting party. Perhaps the noises from that device heralded their arrival.”
    • (Responding remark): “So, Vlaakith indeed wishes to hunt us down.”

Gauntlet of Shar

Approaching Thorm Mausoleum:

  • (Upon approaching Thorm Mausoleum): “These sigils... druids and Harpers alike tried to seal away Ketheric Thorm in his foul tomb. To no avail.”
  • (Interacted with the signs on the old graves near the Mausoleum): “Some of our war dead, from so long ago. Buried in haste when we had to flee the curse.”
  • (Found Dark Justiciar corpses near temple, knows the story): “The remains of Dark Justiciars. They were formidable in battle, all that time ago...”
    • (Not knowing the story): “Slain Dark Justiciars. Still where we left them to rot, all those years ago.”

Inside the Mausoleum:

  • (Heard Balthazar’s warning from the skull): “Balthazar, a necromancer crony of Thorm's.”
    • (Responding remark): “Who knows what unnatural trickery awaits us. We must be cautious.”
  • (Found Isobel’s tomb, haven’t met her): “Ketheric Thorm's daughter. Her death compelled his descent into evil.”
    • (If met Isobel, but not knowing her parentage): “Ketheric's late daughter. Isobel... the name of the cleric at Last Light?”
    • (Knowing both): “Isobel's tomb. But her father would not let her rest.”
  • (Looking at the first mural around Isobel’s tomb): “Moonrise Towers... before Ketheric Thorm offered it over to the shadows.”

At the entrance to the temple itself:

  • (Found the transporting disc to the temple): “That disc can move, I'll wager. But where does it lead?”
    • (Responding remark): “Only one way to find out where it leads to...”
  • (First time entering the temple,  Religion check):
    • (Successful): “A temple of Shar - hidden deep enough to escape the effects of her shadow curse.”
    • (Failed): “A temple of sorts? Though not a terribly inviting one.”
  • (Upon entering the temple, heard the statue talking): “The voice of Shar...? Is she truly present, or a mere illusion for the ears?”

Elsewhere in the inner temple:

  • (Spotted a Cloaker): “Oak Father shield us - a cloaker!”
  • (Found shattered Mirror of Loss,  Arcana check):
    • (Successful): “Sharran magic once imbued this mirror - I can feel it. But it works no more.”
    • (Failed): “Breaking a mirror of this size must lead to quite a lot of bad luck...”
  • (Killed Balthazar): “The corpse-botherer has fallen. No loss.”

Dealing with Yurgir and Lyrthindor:

  • (Looking at orthon’s corpse installations in the temple, knowing about his presence): “This orthon seems to show artistic flair in displaying his victims. A missed calling, perhaps.”
    • (If not knowing about his presence): “Defiled corpses... there is almost a sort of vile artistry in how they are displayed.”
  • (Looking at orthon’s bed): “Imagine choosing this as your place of rest...”
  • (Upon killing Yurgir, knows about Raphael’s demand): “The brute is slain - to Raphael's benefit, it seems.”
    • (If not knowing): “That orthon was far from his natural home. What was he doing here...?”
  • (An infernal circle near the rat altar,  Arcana check):
    • (Successful): “The hallmarks of a ritual... but not one I am familiar with.”
    • (Failed): “A ritual circle - and not of this plane, either. Infernal, I would guess.”
  • (Near the rat altar, found One Becomes Many scroll): “A magic incantation. One that can turn an individual into a horde...”
  • (Fighting rats near altar, between waves): “A great horde of rats, but not an endless one, surely. I must keep fighting.”

Passing Trials of Shar:

  • (Near the corridor of trials, heard the statue talking): “That voice... could it be Shar herself? Or some magic echo?”
  • (After finishing first Trial, spotted a gem, not knowing its purpose): “A gem. Some token of reward, perhaps?”
    • (Knowing its purpose): “That gem looks like it belongs upon the altar from earlier.”
  • (After finishing other Trials, spotted a gem, not knowing its purpose): “Another gem. They must have some significance.”
    • (Knowing its purpose): “Another gem. This'll need to go in a socket later.”
  • (In the Gauntlet_of_Shar#The_Silent_Library, pressed the correct button): “That seems to have worked.”
  • (Pick up the Spear of Night, not knowing its purpose): “A curious spear - and perhaps an important one, for it to be hidden like so.”
    • (Knowing its purpose): “An uncommon spear. The one Shadowheart seeks, no doubt.”
  • (Using the second transporting disc, not knowing about further trials): “The disc is moving. There must be even greaters depths to explore in this place.”
    • (Knowing about further trials): “The disc is moving. The Gauntlet of Shar must continue wherever it leads.”

At the Verge of Shadows and in the Shadowfell:

  • (Read a plaque before entering Nightsong’s Prison, not knowing the whole story): “Sounds like sacrifices were carried out beyond here.”
    • (Knowing the story): “The blood of Selûne? I thought we neared Aradin's precious Nightsong, not a sacrifice.”
  • (Upon entering the Shadowfell): “I feel strange... lighter, untethered to the ground. Almost like I could float away.”
  • (Leaving the Shadowfell, Shadowheart disappeared): “What wickedness befell you, Shadowheart? We emerged, but you were not with us.”

Resolving Nightsong’s fate:

  • (Saw Aylin trapped): “Imagine being tormented in this place for so long. It makes me shudder.”
    • (Responding remark): “I knew Ketheric Thom was ruthless, but this is more than I could have fathomed he was capable of.”
  • (Freed Nightsong):
    • (Having Shadowheart in party): “An aasimar at our side. I can think of few allies that could match her.”
    • (Playing as Shadowheart): “You chose well, Shadowheart. You may have angered your goddess, but now we have an aasimar as an ally.”
      • (Responding remark to any of these): “Ketheric Thorm shall be vulnerable now. The time to strike is upon us.”
    • (Without Shadowheart in the party): “She shall be a powerful ally against Ketheric Thorm. I look forward to witnessing her power unleashed against him.”
    • (Responding remark): “And with her free, Thorm is vulnerable. The time to strike is upon us.”
  • (Killed Nightsong):
    • (Having Shadowheart in party/Playing as Shadowheart): “A sorry outcome.”
      • (Responding remark): “You have shed the rarest of blood for your goddess, Shadowheart. I hope it was worth it to you.”
    • (Without Shadowheart in the party): “She is immortal - and enraged. What have we done...?”
      • (Responding remark): “How many times has she died and returned? How much agony has she endured...?”
  • (Surrendered Nightsong to Balthazar (any of three options)): “We just surrendered her...? She could have helped us put a stop to Ketheric Thorm!”
      • (Responding remark to any of three options): “That was not just foolish. It was immoral.”

Moonrise Towers

  • (Reminding the player character about Minthara after her trial): “Minthara may prove useful to us, should we wish to save her...”
  • (Approaching the Moonrise Towers Prison): “Prisoners. More unwilling flesh for the Absolute's schemes.”
    • (Responding remark): “We cannot help them just now. Let us not arouse any suspicion.”
  • (Investigating Oubliette, saw Mind Flayer Colony through a flesh-wrought window): “I can almost see something beyond there... unreachable from here, however.”
  • (Found Research Notes (Balthazar) in his secret room, 1 option): “The Nightsong must be the source of Thorm's invulnerability. Perhaps it can be turned against him.”
    • (2 option): “The Nightsong sounds like the source of Ketheric Thorm's invulnerability.”
    • (3 option): “Perhaps there is a way to turn it against Ketheric Thorm.”
      • (Responding remark 1): “Finding it may not be a simple matter.”
      • (Responding remark 2): “The very same Nightsong that Aradin once sought. What could it be?”
      • (Responding remark 3): “It must be found, first of all. No easy task.”
  • (Found Ritual circle in Balthazar’s secret room): “A ritual circle. The Moonlanterns must receive their enchantments here.”
    • (If Gale knows about it): “This seems like something best left to Gale.”
  • (Before entering the door to the Moonrise Towers Rooftop to fight Ketheric Thorm): “Ketheric Thorm is close. We must take every measure to ready ourselves.”
  • (On the rooftop, looking into the tentacle hole): “Downwards - we need to pursue Ketheric Thorm until this is done.”

Mind Flayer Colony

  • (Entering the colony, investigating): “The illithids' foul roots run deep. Is there no end to this place?”
  • (Looking at neutral Intellect Devourers): “They are not attacking - perhaps they think you are one of their own.”
  • (Approaching Mizora’s pod): “A cambion? The Absolute truly does ensnare all sorts under its foul banner.”
  • (Found brine pool,  Perception check):
    • (Successful): “No tadpoles present. Have they all been put to use...?”
    • (Failed): “A brine pool - depleted of tadpoles, blessedly.”
    • (Caught the last tadpole): “A curious-looking tadpole. May be of interest.”

In the Necrotic Laboratory and Morgue:

  • (Near the ritual circle,  Arcana check):
    • (Successful): “Necromantic rites. The victims are being leached of all life, and left as undead slaves.”
    • (Failed): “A foul-seeming place. Nothing good can come from lingering here.”
  • (Solved the Brain Puzzle): “The way is clear. Time to see what awaits.”
  • (Reading illithid manuscripts,  Arcana check):
    • (Successful): “The language of the mind flayers. As indecipherable as it is unnatural.”
    • (Failed): “Perhaps someone knows what this means - but not me.”
  • (Found Mol’s eyepatch, met her): “That's Mol's eyepatch... in this place? Silvanus protect her.”
    • (Never met her): “Someone lost their eyepatch. Hopefully that's all they lost.”
  • (Entering the Morgue): “That smell... How much butchery has this place seen?”
    • (Splattered with blood spilled from the Morgue chute): “Damn. Now I smell like a wolf pack's supper...”
    • (Looking at corpse that dropped out with blood from the chute): “A victim of Moonrise Towers. Nothing is sacred in that place.”

Final fight with Ketheric Thorm:

  • (Before descending to Ketheric, saw nautiloid fleet): “A whole armada of nautiloids... enough for an army of 'True Souls'...”
  • (Taking the elevator down to Ketheric): “This place seems endless. Need to remain on guard - who is to say what awaits?”
  • (Started a final fight with Ketheric, Nightsong captured again): “Ketheric's unstoppable so long as he feeds on the Nightsong - we must free her.”
  • (Killed Ketheric Thorm, Shadow Curse lifted): “Ketheric Thorm's demise was the deathblow against the Shadow Curse also. We have done all that was asked about us. Thaniel will soon take care of the rest.”
  • (If the Shadow Curse wasn’t lifted): “At last, it is done. Ketheric Thorm will rise no more. All those who did not live to see this day can finally rest.”
  • (Took Ketheric’s Netherstone after killing him as Apostle of Myrkul): “It is done. Ketheric Thorm is no more. Now the land can heal and the dead can rest, avenged.”

The Astral Plane

  • (While the player character is suppressed by the Voice of the Absolute): “What's happening - are you hurt?”
  • (Entered the Astral Plane within the Astral Prism): “Where is the visitor from your dreams?”
  • (Saw the corpses of the Orpheus’s Royal Guard): “Not demons then, but githyanki.”
  • (Tried to attack Orpheus): “No use. He cannot be harmed, or freed.”
  • (Observing the rocks that Orpheus is chained to): “These rocks are not natural. They will not yield to any strike.”
  • (Returned to the camp after meeting the Emperor): “That was ample excitement for one evening. We should rest.”

At the camp

  • (Waiting for Shadowheart to speak with Aylin 1): “Shadowheart longs to speak to Dame Aylin. I should wait until she is free.”
    • (Waiting for Shadowheart to speak with Aylin 2): “I ought to leave this to Shadowheart. She needs answers.”
  • (Picked the Qua'nith Psionic Detector from Voss’s body): “A curious item. What is its purpose?”
  • (Picked the note from Voss’s body): “Voss intends to meet with someone in Sharess' Caress - an inn in Baldur's Gate. This may warrant investigation.”

Act Three

Rivington

  • (On seeing the refugee camp in Rivington): “All these people, fleeing for their lives... only to be corralled like cattle”
  • (Read the poster about Gortash’s ordain/Arfur’s pass): “Gortash is to become Archduke? We need to reach Wyrm's Rock.”
  • (Felt the earthquake for the first time): “The ground trembles - what is happening?”
    • (Responding remark): “An earthquake - but they are not commonplace here, surely?”
    • (After the second earthquake): “More earthquakes. Something must be badly amiss, below the ground.”
    • (After the third earthquake): “More tremors. Will they ever cease?”
  • (Met Orin in disguise for the first time): “Orin is a shapeshifter. Who is to say when she was within our reach, but we did not notice...”
    • (After meeting her a second time): “Orin toys with us like a cat with a wounded mouse. But to what end?”
  • (Near Abandoned Windmill, heard screams from beneath): “An anguished cry - coming from under the windmill.”
    • (In the windmill basement, looking at the player who ate illithid’s brain): “Such foulness. Unnatural.”
    • (If agreed to find food for the illithid, but it was gone): “The mind flayer has fled. Who knows what chaos it may unleash in the city.”
  • (Found a missing part (any of the two) of the dead refugee’s ring): “This forms a ring, once reunited with the piece found earlier.”
  • (Saw the gnomes’ footprints outside the cave,  Perception check):
    • (Successful): “A trail - small footprints. They lead to that cave.”
    • (Failed): “My senses betray me. What is it that I'm missing?”
  • (Trying to open the Angleiron's Cellar hatch from inside): “Locked - and no keyhole in sight. This must open by other means.”
  • (Trying to open it from the smithy): “Locked from the other side. What lies beyond?”
  • (Found blood puddle in Rivington smithy, if previously met Orin impersonating Gyldro Angleiron): “Fresh blood. And no blacksmith.”

Encounter with smugglers and the Guild thugs

  • (Found headless corpse,  Medicine check):
    • (Successful): “That blood smells fresh. Whoever took his head did so recently.”
    • (Failed): “Head's gone, with the rest left for the crows.”
  • (Saw the ship from Moonrise): “Can it be? I believe that's the same ship that was docked at Moonrise Towers.”
  • (Saw smugglers and The Guild thugs ready for fight): “A fight is brewing. Playing peacemaker could just make things worse.”
  • (Found tadpole barrels after the fight): “Tadpoles. It cannot bode well if these are being smuggled into the city...”

Circus of the Last Days

  • (Saw Akabi’s fake treasure, 1): “A fake.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s fake treasure, 2): “A cheap imitation.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s fake treasure, 3): “Nothing but a forgery.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s junk prizes, 1): “Fake. This has no value.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s junk prizes, 2): “This is but a forgery.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s junk prizes, 3): “A weak imitation.”
  • (Saw Akabi’s junk prizes, 4): “A hollow forgery.”
  • (Sent to the jungle by Akabi): “What is this place...? Wilderness abound, but not of any sort I am familiar with...”
    • (Returned from jungle): “Free, finally. That djinni will regret such trickery.”
  • (After the fight with false Dribbles, knows the story): “He was a shapeshifter? Then we are lucky to have not slaughtered an innocent in front of an audience...”
    • (Not knowing the story): “Another shapeshifter. At least we did not kill a true clown before an audience.”
  • (If the Circus has left): “The circus... what came of it?”

Sword Coast Couriers

  • (Found pigeon’s remains, doesn’t have Danzo’s quest): “Pigeon feathers, yet no bird. Perhaps a cat is enjoying its prize somewhere.”
  • ( Nature check successful): “Pigeon feathers. Perhaps belonging to one of the post house's flock?”
    • (Failed): “Grey feathers. From what?”
  • ( Investigation check successful): “More pigeon remains. Headed for the Open Hand temple, by the look of it.”
    • (Failed): “Pigeon blood. Some cat dines well tonight, perhaps.”
  • (Conclusion, before the Open Hand Temple): “The missing letters may be found within.”

Open Hand Temple

  • (At the roof, saw Tara, haven’t recruited Gale): “A tressym. I am blessed to see one outside of books.”
    • (At the roof, saw Tara, didn’t notice Gale’s symbol): “A cat, with wings...?”
    • (At the roof, saw Tara, recognised Gale’s symbol): “That symbol upon the collar... an acquaintance of yours, Gale?”
    • (At the roof, saw Tara, met her at the camp[3]): “Is that not Gale's tressym companion, Tara? What brings her here?”
    • (At the roof, saw Tara, Gale’s in the party): “That symbol... Gale, is that tressym an acquaintance of yours?”
  • (Opened Lorgan’s chest,  Investigation check successful): “It looks as though there should be more to this chest... A-ha, a false bottom.”
  • (Entered the crypt without Sentient Amulet): “I should bring that amulet - the Mad Monk will not want to miss this.”
    • (Entered the crypt with the amulet in the inventory): “Looks like a crypt. Now to find the final resting place of Shirra Clarwen.”
    • (Found Shirra’s tomb/asked the priests): “She rests here. The reunion beckons...”
    • (Found Shirra’s tomb on their own): “Gone already. Perhaps the amulet can offer some insight.”
    • (Relieved the Cursed Monk): “I think he has parted from the mortal realm. Curious.”
    • (Defeated the Monk and zombies): “An unenviable fate. I almost feel sorry for him.”
  • (Found dead refugees under the temple, knowing about Lorgan’s help): “These must be the poor souls Father Lorgan sought to help.”
    • (Responding remark): “Their bodies were savaged. The priest had little hope of helping them.”
  • (Found dead refugees under the temple, not knowing about Lorgan’s help): “Looks like these people sought shelter in the tunnels.”
    • (Responding remark): “To little avail.”
  • (Found killer’s dagger under the temple, knows its feat): “The dagger that slew Father Lorgan, surely.”
    • (Not knowing its feat): “Gouts of blood spilled here. Perhaps this the place of Father Lorgan's demise.”

Arfur's Mansion

  • (Entering the basement): “Dead air and deep shadows. Not a place to linger in.”
  • (Found a half-stitched bear, knows the story): “These unfinished bears are the same type that were in the barn. Better be careful.”
    • (Found a half-stitched bear, not knowing the story): “A toy bear. Not quite ready for a child's bed just yet.”
  • (Found blackmail letter to Arfur, been in the barn, haven’t met him): “Explosives. This toymaker must be intent on shedding children's blood.”
      • (Responding remark): “The toys from the barn - this is where he crafted those murderous little things.”
    • (Found blackmail letter to Arfur, been in the barn, met him): “That vile craven Arfu is planting explosives in toys meant for refugee children.”
    • (Found blackmail letter to Arfur, haven't been in the barn, met him): “This bear totem is highly suspect. Arfu had better not be putting them into the wrong hands.”
    • (Found blackmail letter to Arfur, haven't been in the barn, haven’t met him): “Something is amiss here. The owner of this place should be held to account for these - and any others should be found.”
  • (Found stuffed bears in the Requisitioned Barn, knowing the story): “Bears? Not the most dignified depiction...”

    • (Told Aylin the truth about Lorroakan): “We should follow along, and offer our aid against Lorroakan.”
  • (Found first letter from Orin): “A letter from Orin? Grim tidings, no doubt.”
    • (Found second letter from Orin): “A missive from Orin. An ill omen.”
    • (Found third letter from Orin): “A letter from Orin. If only I could just burn the foul thing, but I must not.”
  • (If Yenna was killed in the fight with Orin): “Rest now, little one. You deserved better than this.”

Endgame

Morphic Pool

  • (Climbed on its shore): “I am blessed to be without a tadpole - the brain's hold must be strong here.”
    • (Responding remark): “We must be getting close.”
  • (Saw how the Netherbrain affects avatar): “The Netherbrain is strong here, going by your reaction.”
    • (Responding remark): “The brain's power - try to withstand it.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “The brain's power grows stronger still. Fight it, however you can.”
  • (Getting closer to the brine pool): “The brain torments you relentlessly. We must be close.”
  • (Gave the toy bear to the dead smuggler’s sibling): “They fought well, right to the end. May they find the peace denied to them in life.”
    • (Responding remark): “Yet another reason to put an end to all of this.”
  • (Forgot Gortash’s Netherstone): “We cannot face the brain - not without all three stones.” (Only played if Gortash was killed by the brain at the pool shore)
    • (Responding remark): “The missing stone must be nearby.”
  • (Coming close to Netherbrain): “The brain's power must be strong here. I am blessed to be uninfected.”

Astral Plane

  • (Spurned the Emperor, deciding what to do): “Options seem painfully limited, I must admit.”
    • (Spurned the Emperor, but left with no options to win): “And we are without the means to free Orpheus.”
    • (If still having the Astral-Touched Tadpole): “We still have the means of assimilating Orpheus.”
    • (If having the Orphic Hammer): “We shall have to free him.”
    • (Responding remark): “I just hope he is amenable.”
  • (Saw a companion transforming): “A ghastly spectacle. I shudder to think what it felt like.”
  • (Watched Orpheus being consumed, either by the Emperor or by an illithid companion): “A vile spectacle.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Not a sight to relish.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “Let us just hope that we chose wisely.”

The High Hall

  • (Returned to Baldur’s Gate from the Astral Plane): “Oak Father preserve us - how are we to get through all this?”
    • (Responding remark): "Be it by stealth or force, we have to press onwards."
  • (If avatar has dropped the Triune Netherstone): “We are helpless against the Netherbrain without that!”
    • (If avatar has dropped the Triune Netherstone 2): “We cannot prevail without that!”
  • (Saw the Netherbrain’s stem base): “The lowermost part of the Netherbrain. We need to climb higher if we are to stop it.”
    • (Touched the stem base): “The brain is not in reach yet - we must ascend higher.”
  • (A nautiloid prepared to bombard): “Blasted nautiloid! Need to get to the Netherbrain, now!”
  • (Walking up the High Hall, 1): “There are too many foes to defeat - reaching the brain is the only hope!”
    • (Walking up the High Hall, 2): “The enemies numbers are too great - we must press forward, before they swamp us!”
  • (Entering the Upper City Sewers): “Stealth would be wise.”

Atop the Netherbrain

  • (Started the fight): “The Crown is ahead - time to cast the spell again.”
    • (Started the fight with no illithid in the party): “ Use the tadpole - dominate the brain!”
  • (The Emperor died/killed him): “He is no more. Wise, perhaps. Could we ever have truly turned our backs on him?”
  • (Hurry warning 1): “Hurry, get to the brain and cast the spell to compel it to submit! I shall buy you time!”
  • (Hurry warning 2): “There is no end to these foes - we have to dominate the brain!”
  • (Hurry warning 3): “ Dominate the brain - do it now or all is lost!”
  • (Started opening the portal): “Keep them at bay until the spell is complete!”
  • (Opened the portal): “A rift... Can it be a way inside its mind?”

Calling for aid through Gather Your Allies (class action)

Calls for Shadowheart's or Viconia's Sharrans, as well as Kith'rak Voss' dragon are common for all playable characters. Calling for Lorroakan, unlike Rolan, does not have a corresponding dialogue file.[verify]

  • (Called for Aylin): “Dame Aylin will surely aid us. The Moonmaiden's very own daughter knows our cause is just.”
  • (Called the Armoured Owlbear): “Young owlbear, show us your fury!”
  • (Called for Astarion’s undead horde): “Astarion, bring forth your undead warriors!”
  • (Called for Auntie Ethel): “Time to put your trickery to good use, hag.”
  • (Called for Florrick and the Flaming Fist): “Florrick - I need your aid!”
  • (Called for a Gondian Steel Watcher): “Steel Watcher - those foes are for you!”
  • (Called for Harpers): “Harpers - to me!”
  • (Called for the Ironhands): “Grenadiers - unleash your bombardment!”
  • (Called for Isobel): “Isobel - lend us your healing touch!”
  • (Called for Mizora): “Mizora, aid us!”
  • (Called for Nine-Fingers): “Lady Keene, we need you in this fight.”
  • (Called for Rolan): “Rolan, let loose your barrage. Rain down fire!”
  • (Called for Ulma and the Gur): “Gur hunters, come to our aid!”
  • (Called for Valeria’s City Watch): “City Watch! Defend your home!”
  • (Called for Yurgir): “Yurgir, to the hunt!”
  • (Called for Zevlor and the Hellriders): “Veterans - join the fray!”
  • (Called for the Zhentarim): “Zhentarim! To battle!”

  • (Trying to use Regeneration pod, never used it before, ability check successful): “It draws power from anyone on that cradle... someone needs to assume the position or it's useless.”

  • (Saw the corpses of the Orpheus’s Royal Guard): “Not demons then, but githyanki.”
